name: Head to UBC Morning 2026
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e6240fd13450938c58ea02a2948e07de0e818fb2/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) ### *Please note: we are hosting two mini-competitions on the same day! They have different events — you can choose between [Head to UBC Morning 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HeadtoUBCMorning2026) and [Head to UBC Afternoon 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HeadtoUBCAfternoon2026). You can only participate in one of the two competitions. If you register for both of them, only one registration will be accepted.* To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). You are also welcome to join the Facebook group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). Please **review all of the tabs on this website**. You **only need to show up for events that you're competing in**, but we encourage you to stay longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly in the afternoon — **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. An email with information and reminders will be sent a few days before the competition. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media, and other digital platforms.
